answers.core:
Simplicity, compatibility and high demand of utility are the keys to propose this post. 
First, this modification happens only on `CircleShape2D`, so no extra additions of new shape classes, which saves the space for other potential class definition and keeps minimal addition to the size of the software.
Second, since this happens on `CircleShape2D`, it means compatibility, which means that the version without this implementation can be smoothly updated to this version, without extra cost or lost.
Third, I believe not only me, but also other devs are thinking of this feature or enhancement, as this is very very very common to use, but sadly it's not implemented yet
answers.workaround: As `Shape2D` can be extended, ofc we can create a new class named `SectorShape2D` for this use. However, it needs more lines of code to be implemented rather than just a few lines.
